findings.issue: The Parameters table lists `--severity-threshold` (default `P2`, "Minimum severity to report"), but `/deep:review` has no such flag: it is absent from the Workflow Flag Surface in `.skilled/commands/deep/review.md` (which states that table is the only list of flags) and from `assets/deep-review.yaml`. `severityThreshold` exists only as a config value the workflow always writes as the literal "P2" (`deep-review.yaml:871`), and no runtime script reads it, so no severity filtering ever happens. A reader passing `--severity-threshold=P1` gets no filtering and an unrecognized token, not the documented behaviour. The row should be deleted (or renamed to the config field with a note that it is written, not honoured).

evidence.out: (no output: the flag appears in no command doc, workflow YAML or runtime script; the only hit in the repository is quick-reference.md:52)

findings.issue: Under "Composite convergence votes `STOP` only after", the doc says "Dimension coverage reaches 100% across the 4-dimension model". The convergence script builds the coverage universe from `config.reviewDimensions` and requires every configured dimension to be covered: `totalDimensions: dimensions.length` and `missingDimensions: dimensions.filter((dimension) => coverage[dimension] !== true)` (convergence.cjs:1599-1608), and the reducer appends every configured custom name after the canonical four (`buildDimensionUniverse`, reduce-state.cjs:1223-1235). With a custom dimension configured (e.g. `performance`), 100% of the four canonical dimensions is not the bar; the custom name must be covered too. The same document says as much elsewhere ("A node needs one iteration per configured dimension"), so this line is stale.

fix.old: Dimension coverage reaches 100% across the 4-dimension model
fix.new: Dimension coverage reaches 100% across every configured dimension (the four by default)

findings.issue: The `continuedFromRun` field is described as the "Count of completed iteration records", but `step_extend_completed_run` counts every distinct run number among all `type: "iteration"` rows, error and timeout rows included (`const continuedFromRun = new Set(rows.filter(row => row.type === "iteration")...)`, deep-review.yaml:529-532) — the loop-protocol reference states this correctly ("distinct runs among the iteration records, error and timeout rows included"). A run whose trailing iterations failed therefore gets a larger `continuedFromRun`, and so a larger `maxIterations = continuedFromRun + N`, than "completed records" implies.

evidence.out:
529:            const continuedFromRun = new Set(rows
530-              .filter((row) => row && row.type === "iteration")
531-              .map((row) => (Number.isInteger(row.iteration) ? row.iteration : Number(row.run)))
532-              .filter((run) => Number.isInteger(run))).size;

fix.old: Count of completed iteration records when `--extend=N` reopened a completed run (`completed-continue`).
fix.new: Count of distinct iteration runs in the state log, error and timeout rows included, when `--extend=N` reopened a completed run (`completed-continue`).
